name: consulting-monorepo
description: Consulting & Procurement Intelligence Platform (Next.js Frontend, Node.js Backend, PostgreSQL Database)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,green" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,green" "npm --prefix frontend run start" "npm --prefix backend run start"
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:coverage && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.test:ci: npm --prefix backend run test:ci && npm --prefix frontend run test:ci
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix backend run lint
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.quality: npm run build && npm run test:coverage && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run db:push && npm run check:budget
scripts.deps:check: npm --prefix backend outdated || exit 0 && npm --prefix frontend outdated || exit 0
scripts.deps:audit: npm --prefix backend audit && npm --prefix frontend audit
